headline: FIA president says Qatar and Abu Dhabi will go ahead
body: Mohammed Ben Sulayem says the final two races of 2026 are going ahead as planned. He says he cannot predict what happens and that Imola remains ready to step in as a replacement finale if needed. The FIA has also prepared a second team of officials in case government travel restrictions stop key staff attending.

headline: FIA requires F1 and non-F1 staff to be separated from 2027
body: New Operations Regulations approved by the World Motor Sport Council add a 12-page section on cost cap compliance. Factories must have restricted areas for F1 staff only, secured by electronic access with logs kept for three years, and F1 and non-F1 staff can no longer work from the same offices. IT systems must also be fully segregated.
